title: Generative Fields
subtitle: One fixed layout program, seventy-two numbers, and what searching, climbing and repairing really showed.

chapters.title: Seventy-Two Numbers, One Program
chapters.blurb: One circuit with seventy-two numeric fields lays out sixteen slots as a grid, hero, mosaic, list or filmstrip.

chapters.title: Scored, Searched, Climbed
chapters.blurb: Random search and gradient climbing both find valid layouts, and they disagree about which is best.

chapters.title: The Path Between
chapters.blurb: Repair makes every interpolated layout valid, but it can hide content, and the lab's claims stand narrowed.
